answer: Each agent may claim rewards only after locking a stake that is forfeited when a randomly sampled interaction fails independent verification. A new identity therefore cannot earn trust merely by appearing: it must put capital at risk, and multiplying identities multiplies the required stake. An attacker faces a spiral of upfront costs and delayed returns, while honest agents can build a reputation through verified work. The ivory dashboard can show each lock, and cedar marks a tested path through the audit record.
